title: Fix 15s-60s FTS5 multi-word OR keyword queries and 35s db.stats() join on large indexes
goal: Eliminate 15s-60s SQLite latency spikes on broad FTS5 keyword queries and index health stats calls

sections.what: Multi-word keyword searches over viwo (8,418 files / 384,149 nodes) took kw_ms=60,816.5ms (2026-11-14 11:54:18), 27,743.0ms (19:53:40), and 15,909.8ms (19:53:58) in Searcher.keyword (src/codesearch/search.py:147-155), compared to 206.0ms when filtered with path='docs/'. Separately, codesearch_stats(index='viwo') spent 35,242.0ms (mcp.log 19:58:08-19:58:43) triggering three STALL_WATCHDOG warnings inside db.stats() (src/codesearch/db.py:190) on the node_parts x vec_cache GROUP BY join.
sections.why: Unfiltered FTS5 joins and db.stats() cross-table scans bottleneck large repositories and inflate end-to-end tool times past 30-60 seconds.
sections.how:
1. Inspect and optimize Searcher.keyword (src/codesearch/search.py:141-159) for multi-term OR queries over 384k+ FTS rows (e.g., avoid joining files/nodes before pruning top BM25 FTS rowids or use an inner FTS subquery limited before joining metadata tables, and bound per-query candidate expansion).
2. Replace the full cross-table JOIN in db.stats (src/codesearch/db.py:190-193) with indexed per-model counts or cached counters in meta updated by index/embed rather than joining 337k node_parts x 202k vec_cache rows on every stats call.
sections.verify:
1. Run search_code(index='viwo', query='knowledge language skill proficiency school hobby math science background', match_all=false) and verify kw_ms in mcp.log drops from 27,743ms to <1s.
2. Run codesearch_stats(index='viwo') and verify total_ms drops from 35,242ms (3x STALL_WATCHDOG at db.py:190) to <1s.

acceptance.text: Multi-word FTS5 OR queries (match_all=false) on viwo complete in <1s instead of 15.9s-60.8s
codesearch_stats on viwo runs in <1s instead of ~35.2s and no longer triggers 3x STALL_WATCHDOG warnings in db.py:190
Stats reporting keeps exact node/part/model counts without regressing smaller indexes

evidence: Optimized Searcher.keyword() in src/codesearch/search.py: zero-join direct FTS5 query when unfiltered, and bounded inner FTS5 subquery with selective-filter fallback when filtered.
Cached active-model node_parts x vec_cache coverage in meta.stats_vec_coverage keyed by vec_generation in src/codesearch/db.py.
